speaker: Samantha
text: We are tempted to think that our little “sips” of online connection add up to a big swallow of real conversation. No, they don't. Even though all of these sips have their places - in politics, commerce, romance, and friendship, I would claim, no matter how valuable they are, it's impossible for them to substitute for real conversation, where people exchange ideas and share viewpoints dynamically.
